entry.title: HELEN ANTHONY: Structure Meets Sensuality for S/S 2027

media:group.media:title: HELEN ANTHONY: Structure Meets Sensuality for S/S 2027
media:group.media:description:
Helen Anthony spring/summer 2027 ready-to-wear collection #HelenAnthony #SS27
Where heritage meets bold experimentation - witness the sustainable, avant-garde Helen Anthony spring/summer 2027 showcase on FashionTV!
For S/S 27, Helen Anthony delivers a modern, avant-garde interpretation of classic British tailoring that challenges heritage rather than simply preserving it.
Deconstructing the familiar vocabulary of the Savile Row suit, the collection introduces razor-sharp silhouettes, unexpected proportions, and fluid constructions infused with expressive color and sensual movement.
At the core of the brand's vision remains an unwavering commitment to responsible design: every fabric is custom-designed and fully manufactured in the UK, supporting local specialist craftsmanship while minimizing its carbon footprint. The result is a bold, sustainable triumph where British luxury and experimental design seamlessly coexist.

entry.title: HU BING SELECTS: Architectural Armor & Metallic Gauze for S/S 27 | London Fashion Week

media:group.media:title: HU BING SELECTS: Architectural Armor & Metallic Gauze for S/S 27 | London Fashion Week
media:group.media:description:
Hu Bing Selects spring/summer 2027 ready-to-wear collection London Fashion Week #Hu Bing Selects #LFW #SS27
Journey through a millennium of leather craftsmanship - watch Hu Bing Selects’ visionary “Urban Grace” London Fashion Week show now on FashionTV!
Bridging Shanghai and London, past and future, Hu Bing Selects returned to London Fashion Week with “Urban Grace: Leather & Light”, a striking exploration of time and material transformation.
Moving through three distinct imagined temporal chapters — 1930, 2030, and 3030 — the collection redefines leather from ceremonial matte white paired with delicate silk into architectural, gladiatorial armor in cognac and wine red, ultimately evolving into a metallic, weightless second skin.
Beyond its visionary silhouettes worn by top models Qi Qi, Dongna Xie, and Yun Xiang Hao, the showcase marks the debut of Hu Bing’s ""Finishing in China"" initiative.
Developed in collaboration with Haining’s renowned leather supply chain, the collection elevated technical expertise and Chinese craft into a powerful creative act that connects Eastern heritage with Western global runways.

entry.title: LUISA BECCARIA: Milan’s Blooming Sanctuary for S/S 27 | Milan Fashion Week

media:group.media:title: LUISA BECCARIA: Milan’s Blooming Sanctuary for S/S 27 | Milan Fashion Week
media:group.media:description:
Luisa Beccaria spring/summer 2027 ready-to wear collection Milan Fashion Week #LuisaBeccaria #SS27 #MFW
Wear the landscape - explore the romantic world and artisanal details of Luisa Beccaria spring/summer 2027 today on FashionTV!
Set against the Art Nouveau backdrop of Milan’s Acquario Civico, Luisa Beccaria’s S/S 2027 collection, “Herbarium”, is a sensual celebration of botanical poetry and aquatic charm.
The Maison brings its iconic floral universe to life like a living archive of nature: hand-knitted cloud-light mohair, sheer organza, and rustling brocades are adorned with three-dimensional sequins, delicate ruches, and embroidered pomegranates.
From sunlit countryside breakfasts to ethereal evening celebrations, fluid bustier dresses, trapeze minis, and romantic ruffled trousers dance in a palette inspired by dawn, sky, and sea.
Paired with artisanal footwear crafted in collaboration with Kathryn Lipman for Sandro Vicari, “Herbarium” turns high fashion into a wearable, blooming sanctuary.

entry.title: SAINT LAURENT: Haute Precision, Seductive Danger for S/S 27 | Paris Fashion Week

media:group.media:title: SAINT LAURENT: Haute Precision, Seductive Danger for S/S 27 | Paris Fashion Week
media:group.media:description:
Saint Laurent spring/summer 2027 ready-to-wear collection Paris Fashion Week #SaintLaurent #AnthonyVaccarello #PFW #SS27
Head-to-toe gold leaf, snake heels, and pure couture drama - admire the spring/summer 2027 golden alchemy of Saint Laurent by Anthony Vaccarello!
For summer 2027, Anthony Vaccarello envelops Saint Laurent in a hypnotic, head-to-toe study of a single magical hue: gold. Drawing on Yves Saint Laurent’s legendary love for the shade, Vaccarello explores its transformative power across a vast spectrum, from Byzantine and Renaissance gold to matte, burnished, and Brutalist tones.
House archetypes like sahariennes, trenches, and short suits with sharp shoulders are gilded in luminous brocades, gold-leaf latex, lame, and guipure lace, balancing haute couture craftsmanship with modern, wearable edge.
Complemented by monumental filigree jewelry and sculptural snake heels, the golden spell eventually yields to a poetic close of nimbus-cloud black evening gowns - a haunting final reminder that what passes often leaves the brightest light behind.

entry.title: MULBERRY: Inside Christopher Kane’s Radical S/S 27 Debut | London Fashion Week

media:group.media:title: MULBERRY: Inside Christopher Kane’s Radical S/S 27 Debut | London Fashion Week
media:group.media:description:
Mulberry spring/summer 2027 ready-to-wear collection London Fashion Week #Mulberry #SS27 #LFW
Where British utility collides with high craft - witness the transformative debut of Mulberry spring/summer 2027 now on FashionTV!
For S/S 2027, Mulberry opens a transformative chapter with the debut of Christopher Kane as Creative Director. Fusing establishment elegance with a subcultural edge, the inaugural collection explores the clash of British life, where school uniforms collide with leather, and parkas veil refined dresses.
Kane draws directly from Mulberry’s Somerset roots and archive codes, translating the iconic angles of the Bayswater bag into crisp style lines across tailoring, coats, and knitwear, while hardware like the Postman’s Lock finds new purpose on belts and footwear.
From abstracted axe motifs symbolizing craft and renewal to the revival of Mulberry’s original 1990s sweatshirt, the collection honors heritage not through nostalgia, but as a living, electric force for the modern wardrobe.

entry.title: BALMAIN: Cinematic Glamour & Rock 'n' Roll Couture for S/S 27 | Paris Fashion Week

media:group.media:title: BALMAIN: Cinematic Glamour & Rock 'n' Roll Couture for S/S 27 | Paris Fashion Week
media:group.media:description:
Balmain spring/summer 2027 ready-to-wear collection Paris Fashion Week #balmain #ss27 #pfw #parisfashionweek #AntoninTron
Where Parisian couture meets West Coast counterculture: witness the mesmerizing Balmain S/S 2027 collection on FashionTV today!
For spring/summer 2027, Creative Director Antonin Tron orchestrates a breathtaking synthesis of French haute couture and West Coast counterculture at Paris’s historic Hotel de Maisons.
The collection bridges the extreme mid-century draping and wild animalia of founder Pierre Balmain with the mystic, sun-scorched energy of 1960s Joshua Tree and Laurel Canyon.
Cinematic silhouettes range from sinuous, body-deifying silk dresses steeped in LA fever-dream florals to louche, rock-idol leather tailoring - featuring eel-skin blousons, snake-print coats, and sleek tab-front trousers. Sculpted agate-heeled mules and the fluid new Sphynx pouch accent the electric palette of West Coast dawns and dusk-lit golds, delivering an empowering, modern vision of glossy, uncompromising glamour.

entry.title: AHLUWALIA: Togetherness, Optimism, & Radical Lightness for S/S 27 | London Fashion Week

media:group.media:title: AHLUWALIA: Togetherness, Optimism, & Radical Lightness for S/S 27 | London Fashion Week
media:group.media:description:
Ahluwalia Spring/Summer 2027 ready-to-wear collection London Fashion Week #Ahluwalia #SS27 #LFW Experience the vibrant spirit of “Revel” - watch the Ahluwalia S/S 27 London Fashion Week runway show now on FashionTV!
Unveiled inside the grand surroundings of Rosewood London during London Fashion Week, Ahluwalia’s spring/summer 2027 collection, titled “Revel”, proposes optimism and togetherness as the most enduring answers in an uncertain age. Creative Director Priya Ahluwalia transformed early research on historical resistance movements into a poignant study of joy as liberation.
Drawing inspiration from unguarded photographs of off-duty Black Panthers, the pan-African spirit of FESTAC ’77, and the incendiary polyrhythms of Fela Kuti alongside Mumbai's underground rap scene, the collection proves that gathering itself remains a radical, beautiful act. Marking an evolution in design, Ahluwalia’s signature draping shifts outward, claiming space through low-back puffball tops, voluminous dresses, and soft organza layers across both menswear and womenswear.
Protective water-resistant fabrics and 1970s-inspired leather outerwear are balanced by tactile mohair knits, rippling fringe tuxedos, and an instinctive palette drawn from Pan-African art.
Elevating the presentation, the runway featured an extended Ahluwalia x Puma collaboration starring reworked T7 track jackets and primary-colored Speedcat sneakers, alongside hand-strung bead bag charms created with poppi and an immersive, water-inspired wallpaper mural created with Calico Wallpaper.

entry.title: Elisabetta Franchi: Second Skin Sensuality for S/S 27 | Milan Fashion Week

media:group.media:title: Elisabetta Franchi: Second Skin Sensuality for S/S 27 | Milan Fashion Week
media:group.media:description:
Elisabetta Franchi spring/summer 2027 ready-to wear collection Milan Fashion Week #Elisabetta Franchi #SS27 #MFW
Discover how Elisabetta Franchi is shifting the paradigm of power dressing for S/S 27 - watch the show on FashionTV!
Sensuality takes on a bold new dimension as Elisabetta Franchi unveils her spring/summer 2027 collection at Milan Fashion Week. Grounded in captivating contrasts, the presentation explores the delicate balance between structural rigor and alluring transparency, where coverage and exposure dance in complete harmony.
Leaving predictable codes behind, the silhouette shifts focus to framed shoulders and exposed collarbones, setting a new tone for modern power dressing. The collection centers on the concept of a second skin - transforming sheer tights into sculptural dresses, skirts, and opera gloves that embrace the body’s contours.
Architectural maxi blazers, trench coats, and signature corsets feature athletic touches like cycling shorts and liquid-shine leather, seamlessly elevating daytime staples into glamorous eveningwear.
Rich textures steal the show: micro-jaguar motifs collide with oversized sequins, eel-printed leather, and cascading ruched jersey, set against a sophisticated palette of warm camel, deep tobacco, midnight black, and striking Red Velvet.
Designed for the cosmopolitan, confident woman, Elisabetta Franchi’s S/S 27 collection stands as an unapologetic celebration of strength, grace, and Italian sartorial mastery.

entry.title: Emma D’Arcy Leads Nan Goldin’s Raw Denim Campaign for Acne Studios

media:group.media:title: Emma D’Arcy Leads Nan Goldin’s Raw Denim Campaign for Acne Studios
media:group.media:description:
#acnestudios #emmadarcy
Witness thirty years of denim legacy - experience Emma D’Arcy through the raw lens of Nan Goldin in Acne Studios’ 30th-anniversary campaign on FashionTV!
To celebrate three decades of boundary-pushing design, Acne Studios returns to its foundational element - denim - with a landmark 30th-anniversary campaign shot by legendary photographer Nan Goldin.
Completing a lineup of close brand collaborators, actor Emma D’Arcy steps into the spotlight as the campaign’s final, magnetic face. Shot with Goldin’s signature raw intimacy, D’Arcy captures the gritty, authentic spirit of creative director Jonny Johansson’s universe.
Instead of polished fashion portraiture, the campaign strips away pretense to focus on real personal connection, highlighting how Acne Studios’ signature denim remains an enduring, second-skin canvas for modern cultural icons.

entry.title: GISELA: Ocean Whispers & Golden Hours for S/S 27 | Gran Canaria Swim Week

media:group.media:title: GISELA: Ocean Whispers & Golden Hours for S/S 27 | Gran Canaria Swim Week
media:group.media:description:
Gisela swimwear & resort collection S/S 27 Gran Canaria Swim Week #Gisela #swimwear #GCSW
Sun-kissed silhouettes, vibrant prints, and effortless beachwear - enjoy Gisela S/S 2027 on FashionTV!
Taking center stage at Gran Canaria Swim Week 2026 - Europe's premier international runway event for resort and beachwear - Spanish label Gisela unveiled a captivating collection that seamlessly bridges intimate comfort with effortless coastal sophistication.
Set against the sun-drenched backdrop of the Canary Islands, the presentation celebrated the natural beauty of the female form through lightweight, body-conscious tailoring and refined poolside elegance. The collection effortlessly weaves vibrant tropical colorways and soft Mediterranean hues with Gisela’s signature mastery of fit and technical construction.
Fluid cover-ups, high-waisted bikinis, and sleek one-pieces featured intricate drapery, sheer mesh overlays, and subtle shimmer textures designed to transition effortlessly from morning dips to sunset lounge gatherings.
Emphasizing comfort without sacrificing allure, Gisela’s 2026 showcase highlights an empowering vision of summer style rooted in confidence, movement, and resort-ready versatility.
